notes:
Recent clips gives the main subject of each completed generation a reusable name. Type that name in a new video prompt to reuse the original opening frame, or choose the subject directly in the gallery. New characters, people, animals and vehicles get names automatically. Extensions and returning subjects keep their names. The gallery also names existing generated clips in your workspace.

A returning solo lead in a new music video can reuse the saved singing voice. The reference image may carry over some of the setting and clothing.

Verified 28 native tests and the screenplay, performance and gallery regressions. Source commit [972db04](https://github.com/CaleMediaDev/cale-ai-workbench/commit/972db04e1a01155e550676abe256a7889e5796ba).
